summary:
Plan for w113 (work-queue#r15) is in .shop/scratch/2-plan/plan.md.
Goes green: the line-break Outline (7 examples) and the 'refused as more than one line first' scenario, both red today on a missing When step. Behind the step, VT, FF, NEL, LS and PS answers land, and the line check runs after the status and log checks.
Retires the deprecated newline scenario with features retire; its own When step is removed too.
Decisions: the break set is r15's seven code points, so FS, GS and RS still land (r15 lists the set exactly); the one-line check runs first in answer(), per the ruling the scenario pins; work add's LF/CR check stays out of scope (r15 names answers only); the refusal's wording is open as long as it says an answer is one line.
Tests broken: none (notes part 4).
Open cases: FS/GS/RS and answers already on file still split under supervise.held; an empty answer lands; a break at the start or end of an answer.
